title: Smiling Girl in Polka Dot Dress & Boy at Door, 1966 Vintage Photo
description: A classic mid-1960s black-and-white family snapshot capturing a young girl in a mod-style polka dot shift dress standing alongside a young boy in a button-down shirt at an open doorway. Adults are visible standing behind them in the bright sunlit entry. A photo lab date stamp along the right border reads 'JUL 66', anchoring the image to the summer of 1966 in suburban America.
